user.title: Configure OWM Precipitation Forecast
user.description: Set up your OpenWeatherMap precipitation forecast. Get a free API key at https://openweathermap.org/api

data_description.api_key: Your OpenWeatherMap One Call API 3.0 key
data_description.location_name: A friendly name for this location
data_description.polling_interval_option: How often to fetch new forecast data

error.api_key_invalid: Invalid API key. Please check your OpenWeatherMap API key and ensure you have access to the One Call API 3.0.
error.api_connection: Unable to connect to OpenWeatherMap. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.location_invalid: Invalid coordinates. Latitude must be between -90 and 90, longitude between -180 and 180.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs for more details and try again.

abort.already_configured: This location is already configured. Please use a different location or update the existing configuration.

init.title: Configure Precipitation Forecast Options
init.description: Adjust your precipitation forecast settings. Changes will take effect after the next update.

data_description.enable_rain: Track and display rain accumulation forecasts
data_description.enable_snow: Track and display snow accumulation forecasts
data_description.polling_interval_option: How frequently to fetch new forecast data from OpenWeatherMap

snow_ratios.title: Temperature-Adjusted Snow Ratios
snow_ratios.description: Configure how liquid precipitation converts to snow at different temperatures. Higher ratios produce more snow from the same liquid amount. Default ratios are based on typical atmospheric conditions.

data_description.ratio_32: Liquid to snow ratio at 32°F and warmer (typically 10:1)

update_forecast.name: Update Forecast
update_forecast.description: Manually trigger a forecast update for all configured locations.

clear_errors.name: Clear Errors
clear_errors.description: Clear error counters and reset health status.
